Falsifiers pass: 'AC4: a Read in item 1 of a named step does not satisfy item 6 of the same step', 'AC4: the named step is not a PREFIX match for its own numbered items' (deferred-reads.test.mjs:257,270), 'AC2: the same sentence in walk step 1 does not answer for walk step 2', 'AC2: the same sentence under another `##` heading does not answer either' (:355,364), 'D-07: label EXACTNESS, not null-ness, is what blocks a relocation' (:423). Residual, disclosed in SUMMARY open item 2 and confirmed live by me: labels are not required UNIQUE. Running regionLabels over every skill and workflow, exactly one live file has two disjoint regions sharing a label - skills/cad-verifier-contract/SKILL.md, whose <process> block holds two column-0 lists both labelling 1/2/3. No register row targets that file, this is the pre-existing bare-number arm rather than anything this phase introduced, and all four phase-3 target regions I labelled (plan.md 267-336 = check_gate, execute.md 343-402 = execute_parallel(1..6), cad-executor-contract 151-193 = worktree_mode, config.md 71-133 = 'Interactive menu (no args)/Catalog') are uniquely labelled.
